newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hong Kong July re-exports up 13 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong July re-exports up 13 pct.

text.p: The volume of domestic exports in July fell 6.0 percent on year, while re-exports rose 13 percent, Census and Statistics Department data showed.
Total export volume rose 9.4 percent and import volume rose 6.7 percent.
Volume of domestic exports for the first seven months of 1996 decreased by 7.9 percent while volume of re-exports leapt 7.9 percent. Total exports rose 5.1 percent and imports grew by 4.2 percent.
Prices of domestic exports fell 0.1 percent in July 1996 from a year earlier and re-export prices decreased 1.4 percent, import prices also decreased by 3.2 percent.
Prices of domestic exports for the first seven months of 1996 were 0.9 percent higher, while those of re-exports rose 0.1 percent and import prices decreased by 0.6 percent.

Prices are based on unit values which do not take into account changes in the composition or quality of goods traded, except for some selected commodities for which specific price indices are available.
